# Point Vernon Guide

Independent guide to Point Vernon, Hervey Bay, Queensland, Australia. Beaches, foreshore walks, parks and local history.

- [Point Vernon local life](https://pointvernon.com/local-life/): Find Point Vernon transport, parks, dog walks, local help and Saturday activities, with links to Hervey Bay Library and everyday service information.
- [Point Vernon tides and weather](https://pointvernon.com/tides/): Find official tide predictions and Point Vernon weather, see how lower and higher water change the foreshore, and plan a shoreline or boating visit.
- [Point Vernon fishing](https://pointvernon.com/fishing/): Find Point Vernon’s two boat ramps and the official marine-park maps for fishing zones, hook limits, no-anchoring areas and Queensland fisheries rules.
- [Point Vernon beach](https://pointvernon.com/point-vernon-beach/): Explore Point Vernon’s northern and eastern foreshore along The Esplanade, with narrow sand, tidal rock flats and links to named parks and walks.
- [Gables Point beach, Point Vernon](https://pointvernon.com/gables-point-beach/): Plan a Point Vernon stop at The Gables foreshore for a picnic, tidal rock flats and local history, with links to the park and boarding-house story.
- [Moving to or buying in Point Vernon](https://pointvernon.com/moving-buying/): Get to know Point Vernon’s coastal setting and 2021 Census profile, then plan schools, childcare, transport and research for a particular property.
- [Parraweena Park, Point Vernon](https://pointvernon.com/parraweena-park/): Explore Parraweena Park’s eucalypt forest and former bird sanctuary beside Eli Creek in Point Vernon, with the entrance and surviving historic features.
- [What’s on in Point Vernon and nearby](https://pointvernon.com/whats-on/): Join Saturday parkrun in Point Vernon or find library sessions, markets and nearby activities through Hervey Bay and Fraser Coast event calendars.
- [Point Vernon beaches and foreshore](https://pointvernon.com/beaches/): Choose a Point Vernon shoreline stop: Gatakers Bay’s rock flats, ESA Park’s foreshore, The Gables or Eli Creek’s mangroves, with practical comparisons.
- [Point Vernon boat ramps](https://pointvernon.com/boat-ramps/): Compare Point Vernon’s Gatakers Bay and The Gables boat ramps: approaches, lanes, load limits, facilities, tide restrictions and cleaning information.
- [Food and coffee in Point Vernon](https://pointvernon.com/food-coffee/): Find coffee, takeaway and picnic supplies in Point Vernon, with local addresses, business contacts and park ideas for an outing beside the bay.
- [Point Vernon map and access guide](https://pointvernon.com/map-access/): Find Point Vernon’s parks, foreshore and two boat ramps on a local map, then open directions and choose the place that suits your day by the bay.
- [Point Vernon walks and cycling](https://pointvernon.com/walks/): Walk Point Vernon’s paved 5 km foreshore course from Wattle Street, choose a shorter return or plan a gentle bay-view stroll from a named park.
- [Eli Creek beach, Point Vernon](https://pointvernon.com/eli-creek-beach/): Discover Eli Creek’s mangroves and wide tidal flats beside Parraweena Park on Point Vernon’s western shoreline, with a reserve entrance and visit ideas.
- [Point Vernon parks and playgrounds](https://pointvernon.com/parks-playgrounds/): Compare Point Vernon’s ESA Park, The Gables, Webb Park and quieter reserves for playgrounds, picnic facilities, water, shade and a bushland stop.
- [Point Vernon Artificial Reef](https://pointvernon.com/artificial-reef/): Explore Point Vernon’s offshore artificial reef of 88 concrete habitat modules, with the official locality map, launch points and marine-park links.
- [Point Vernon local help and reporting contacts](https://pointvernon.com/local-help/): Save Point Vernon contacts for Council requests, police, wildlife, power and storm assistance, plus the new Hervey Bay Library and Council address.
- [Gatakers Bay, Point Vernon](https://pointvernon.com/gatakers-bay/): Plan a Gatakers Bay visit in Point Vernon: find the Corfield Street boat ramp, understand tides and swimming conditions, and choose a nearby picnic stop.
- [Point Vernon Foreshore Reserve parkrun](https://pointvernon.com/parkrun/): Plan your first Point Vernon Foreshore Reserve parkrun: Saturday 7am start, free 5 km course, registration, parking, facilities and official updates.
- [Point Vernon history](https://pointvernon.com/history/): Discover Point Vernon’s place names, The Gables boarding house, Dunn’s Enclosure, Charles Polson and Parraweena Park through local history guides.
- [Whale watching from Point Vernon](https://pointvernon.com/whales/): Learn when to look for whales from Point Vernon, which broad-water viewpoints may help, what conditions suit land viewing and when to choose a boat tour.
- [Visiting Point Vernon](https://pointvernon.com/visiting/): Plan your first hour in Point Vernon with Gatakers Bay or ESA Park, then add a picnic, foreshore walk or local history stop to a longer visit.
- [Getting around Point Vernon without a car](https://pointvernon.com/getting-around/): Book Point Vernon’s on-demand transport to key Hervey Bay shops and services: operating hours, 50-cent cash fares, booking options and return journeys.
- [Buying in Point Vernon: property checks](https://pointvernon.com/property-checks/): Research a Point Vernon property with Council mapping, planning records, flood and coastal layers, title documents and independent professional advice.
- [Planning an accessible Point Vernon visit](https://pointvernon.com/accessibility/): Find ESA Park’s accessible parking, picnic tables and toilet, plus the sandy beach approach and transport options for a Point Vernon outing.
- [Charles Polson, Pialba and Polson Cemetery](https://pointvernon.com/charles-polson-history/): Follow Charles Polson’s 1870 death and 1887 cemetery entry, the change from Polson to Pialba, and the questions still open in Point Vernon’s history.
- [Accommodation in and near Point Vernon](https://pointvernon.com/accommodation/): Compare Point Vernon holiday parks, cabin and site options, tent and pet conditions, boat parking, direct contacts and operator booking links.
- [Point Vernon coastal wildlife](https://pointvernon.com/coastal-wildlife/): Explore Point Vernon’s rocky reef, Eli Creek mangroves, seasonal shorebirds and ESA Park’s turtle-friendly lights, with places for quiet observation.
- [The Gables, Point Vernon](https://pointvernon.com/the-gables-history/): Discover how Point Vernon’s Bayview Boarding House became The Gables, from its 1888 beginnings and changing owners to its demolition in the 1950s.
- [Dog-friendly Point Vernon foreshore](https://pointvernon.com/dog-friendly-foreshore/): Understand Point Vernon’s signed dog off-leash foreshore areas, current Council rules, playground exceptions and considerate beach etiquette.
- [Things to do in Point Vernon](https://pointvernon.com/things-to-do/): Explore ten Point Vernon outing ideas: Gatakers Bay, park picnics, a paved foreshore walk, local history, Eli Creek and Saturday parkrun.
